P16.answer: Cannot identify a Σ, Χ or Ξ. The leftmost sign on the line (A, left fragment, x~95-130, y~110-165) is an upright with a diagonal running from its top down to the right, plus a short inner stroke: N-/Λ-like, with no zigzag (Σ), no crossing strokes (Χ) and no three bars (Ξ).
P16.evidence: A only; the traces are faint and mixed with corrosion. B strips 1-2 at this spot show only mottling, and C is black (no coverage). An image with better relief lighting of the left fragment would be needed.

P16.answer: No separate Ι seen before it. The straight dark vertical at x~70-75 runs the full height of the image and is the edge of the fragment, not a letter. No cancellation or overwriting marks seen.
P16.evidence: A: edge line continuous above and below the target line. B strip 1: the edge appears as a dark band.

P16.answer: Cannot tell. To the right of the first sign there is a small Λ-like mark near the baseline (x~127-153), a round blob below the line (x~170-200, probably a bubble), then the forms I read in Stage 1 as pos 12 (a top stroke curving down into a base, x~267-327) and pos 11 (an upright with a V-shaped cluster, x~347-397). None of these is a clear Greek letter.
P16.evidence: A only (left fragment). B and C do not resolve these signs.

P17.answer: The only clear word space in A is between Stage-1 pos 10 and pos 11 (x~560-620). A deep fold (x~1090-1170) separates pos 1 at the far right. On that basis: second word (after the isolated pos 1) = ג ע ו ח ע ל ו ב ו (pos 2-10; ג possible (Λ-shaped, alternatives: Greek Λ, א), ע probable, ו probable, ח probable, ע possible, ל probable, ו probable, ב possible, ו probable); third word = ב א ל ? ו ? ל (pos 11-17; ב probable, א probable, ל probable, ? (short upright), ו possible, ? (slanted leaf/oval, ק/ע/ס possible), ל possible). No space is visible inside pos 2-10, so this group may contain more than one word.
P17.evidence: A: column-darkness profile of the target band shows a clean 60px gap at x~555-615 and only 5-15px gaps elsewhere. B strip 1 confirms the third word's ב, א (crossing diagonals) and ל (ascender + horizontal + diagonal). C right strip confirms Λ, diagonals, and arched ח in pos 2-5.

P18.answer: I could not securely identify a word reading חפור. The best candidate for the position the question describes is Stage-1 pos 8 (A x~944-964), which follows a word space: an upright with a stroke joining it from the lower left at mid-height. There is no stroke crossing from upper left to lower right, and no arm at the upper right. It therefore looks more like ג than א. Immediately right of it is pos 7 (x~971-991), an upright with a round loop-head at the top reaching to the baseline (ו or ר), which could be the 'additional letter' asked about. A space containing a small round dot follows (x~905-935). The next group reads ב ו ח ע ס ך ר ס ף (pos 9-17), with no further clear spaces.
P18.evidence: A only for pos 7-8 (grid zoom x~880-1130). B strip 3 does not reach pos 7-8. C strip 1 at this point shows only a box letter with a diagonal (pos 3/4 area). Darkness profile of A shows empty stretches at x~905-935 (dot only) and x~1115-1140 (a possible space between pos 3 and pos 4).

P19.answer: Taking the last two letters as Stage-1 pos 10 (box/U-shaped letter, x~560-633) and pos 12 (x~458-530). Pos 12 is read in B as a roofed letter whose left leg ends in a foot running left, i.e. a ת-like form. Before the break the only traces are: (1) a short lozenge-shaped upright inside pos 12 at x~480-490 (y~130-165), probably its left leg, which A shows detached from the roof; (2) the base/foot stroke at y~178-182 running left to the broken edge at x~455. A long straight scratch runs vertically at x~545 across several lines. Beyond x~455 the copy is smooth lacuna. I see nothing that could be the start of a new word.
P19.evidence: A (grid zoom x~430-560): broken edge with foot stroke reaching it. B right strip (x~990-1050) and B left strip (x~400-470): box with top bar, two uprights, base projecting left of the left upright, strip edge immediately after. C left strip: box shape and nothing further.

P20.answer: Last word = the two letters on the separate far-left piece (beyond the fold at x~200-249). (1) ש possible (alternative ט): U-shape with the left upright hooked at the top, flat base, straight right upright, and a short detached middle stroke rising above the line (x~92-162). (2) ב probable (alternative כ): top bar, right upright, base running left to the edge of the piece (x~36-80). The word ends in a ב/כ form (top + right side + base), not in י-ן and not in ר. Two letters are visible. The fold and the edge of the piece could each hide more letters. If the fold is not a word boundary, the letters at the left end of the main piece (pos 16-19) belong to the same word: a cluster of diagonals, a ר-like top bar + leg, an upright from the line above, and an upright with a short top bar.
P20.evidence: A (grid zoom x~28-175). B strip 1 and C strip 1 do not show the target line of this piece legibly: B shows the upper line (roof + triangle); C is overexposed.

P21.answer: Before the broken edge (A x~545-555) the last traces are: a box letter open at the left (top bar with a triangular serif at the top right, right side, base; x~575-632; ב/כ) and a separate lozenge-shaped upright (x~562-572, y~115-165; ו/י). Nothing more is on the metal. From x~545 to the image edge (x~35) the copy is a smooth filled lacuna, on this line and on the lines above and below. How many letter-spaces are lost cannot be determined from the images. If the line ran on to the image edge, about 9-10 letter-spaces (~50px each) would fit.
P21.evidence: A (zoom x~520-650). B strip 2 and C left strip show the box letters as blurred rectangles and end at the same break. B strip 1 is overexposed.

P22.answer: The last word appears to be Stage-1 pos 16-20 (A x~210-470, after a space at x~495-512). Its first two letters: a closed box with a small triangular apex (pos 16; I read ס/ם and it is presumably the 'מ' of the question), then ש (pos 17, now read as an upright at x~352 with two parallel diagonals joining at its foot). The next letter (pos 18, x~300-348) keeps only a curved stroke across the top that turns down on the right to the baseline. Its lower left is lost in a hole/crack, so a left upright or head cannot be checked. I cannot decide between מ and ט.
P22.evidence: A grid zoom x~270-480; B strip 1 (x~240-450) shows the same arc plus a black hole and a curved crack beneath it. Stage 1 read pos 17 as illegible because I took the upright for a crack. B shows the two diagonals and a faint upright, so I now read ש (possible).

P22.answer: No separate ו is visible between pos 18 and the last letter. A thin vertical crack at A x~290 (B x~255) runs through several lines at that point and could hide or imitate a narrow letter.
P22.evidence: A and B, same crack continuous above and below the line.

P22.answer: ח rather than ה. In B both legs (x~198 and ~238) run up into the roof, which has triangular heads at both ends. In A the legs at x~240 and ~270 also reach the roof. A has a further faint upright at x~210-218 (Stage-1 pos 20) that B does not show; it may be the down-turn of the left head.
P22.evidence: B strip 1 grid zoom (x~165-285) is the clearest; A grid zoom x~195-305.

P22.answer: No clear letters above the line and no correction marks. The only extra features are: a small triangular apex on top of the box letter (pos 16), present in both A and B, so probably part of the letter; the upright of ש, which rises a little above the line; and cracks and a scratch (vertical at x~290 and ~352 in A, a curved crack and a hole under pos 18).

P23.answer: The first sign at the right edge of the written line is a single wedge-shaped upright (A x~1015-1040): thick at the top, tapering downwards, about 3/4 of the line height. I read it as ו (possible; alternative י). It stands immediately before an ע-like letter (pos 2) and a ד-like letter (pos 3), i.e. before a sequence that can be read ע-ד. The gap between the upright and ע is only ~7px, so no clear word space is visible. Right of the upright are a deep fold (x~1060-1140) and a blank area; the only mark there is a dark notch at the very edge (x~1360-1380), which looks like damage.
P23.evidence: A (zoom x~990-1070 and x~940-1418). C strip 2 lower row: upright at the matching place followed by diagonal strokes.

P24.answer: I could not identify a ככ pair at the end of the line, so the count is given for what follows my last read letter (pos 13, ו at A x~466-480). C shows one clear vertical stroke (C x~190, ↔ A ~390), with a short diagonal attached to its lower part, and a possible faint second short stroke (C x~160, ↔ A ~360); left of that C is overexposed and cracked. In A these two places carry two long vertical grooves (x~366 and ~392) that run beyond the line height, so they are cracks or strokes lying along cracks. Further left A has a large diamond-shaped blister (x~230-310) and faint strokes at x~130-175. So: at least 1, probably 2 vertical strokes are visible, and the blister and cracks could hide more. I cannot choose between 2, 4 and 7.
P24.evidence: C strip 1 grid zoom (x~100-420); A grid zoom (x~100-480); B shows only the blister (black hole) and cracks here.

P25.answer: Last two words: (1) ...ש ל = Stage-1 pos 14 (upright with two parallel strokes rising to the upper right; read ע in Stage 1, now read ש possible) + pos 15 (ל, ascender with a hooked body). (2) Last word = pos 16 (a diagonal from the upper right joining a long upright that descends well below the baseline with a foot turning right; could be the 'following ש' of the question, or ק/ץ) + pos 17 (top bar with a small loop at its right end and a diagonal down to the left; ר/ז-like) + [fold at x~235-265] + pos 18 (ב: top bar, right upright, base projecting left). Word space: after ל there is a blank stretch of ~40-50px (x~365-410) with only a bubble in it, about twice the normal letter gap, so a word space is probably present. The last word has 3 visible letters, possibly 4 if one is hidden in the fold. Its last visible letter is ב (probable; alternative כ), with nothing further to the left.
P25.evidence: A grid zoom x~120-470 and darkness profile (zero darkness at x~365-405). B strip 1 confirms the long descender with the right-turning foot (B x~245-330) and the ל-like hook (B x~345-375).

P26.answer: Right to left, near the left end: two base letters (Stage-1 pos 15, x~460-511, and pos 16, x~405-449; each a right upright + base with a top; these are the candidates for ככ). Then: (1) one large hook-shaped sign: a tall vertical coming down from above the line (x~380-392, y~20-140) that turns right at its foot into the base under pos 16 (it may belong to pos 16); (2) a large curved/S-shaped stroke (x~300-350), which B shows as a faint arch; (3)-(4) two arch-shaped (∩) signs, at x~250-305 (clear in A and B) and x~200-250 (B clear, A only two uprights); (5)-(6) two thin vertical strokes at x~185 and x~140-165 (faint in both A and B). Count: 1 large hook sign (possibly 2), 2 arch signs (3 if pos 18 is an arch), 2 vertical strokes (a third cannot be excluded). Left of x~140 the surface is too damaged to read up to the edge.
P26.evidence: A grid zoom x~120-470; B strip 1 grid zoom (x~100-420), where the two arches side by side are the clearest feature and a crack runs at B x~355-365. C does not show this line clearly.

P27.answer: Target-line problem (see Stage-1 notes): the radiographs place the marker on the last line of the right piece. That line was not transcribed in Stage 1, which followed A's marker. On that line, C exposure '13' (clearest) shows two ㄱ-shaped letters (top bar + right side; C x~977-1003 and ~1027-1050), which I take as the ככ pair. To their left follow FOUR arch-shaped signs of the same shape (C x~917-953, 880-907, 847-877, 813-843), closely spaced. Exposure '13B' shows the same two ㄱ-shaped letters and 3 clear arches with a 4th disturbed by a crack; exposure '13C' shows 4 faint rounded shapes. Completeness: a crack runs through the 2nd/3rd arch in two exposures, and left of the 4th arch there is another crack (C x~790) and a faint area, so a 5th sign cannot be fully excluded. No trace of one is visible, and the metal edge lies just below the signs. In A the matching stretch (x~940-1100, y~135-200) is badly damaged: one or two ∩ shapes near x~1049-1080, the rest cracked.
P27.evidence: C exposures 13, 13B, 13C (marker row y~95-130); A grid zooms x~680-1440, y~105-213. The count of four rests mainly on C '13'.

P28.answer: On the separate left piece (beyond the fold at x~360-375), the target line holds only two letters: an upright with a round head (x~262-275; ו, alternative י) and a closed pentagon-shaped box (x~195-245; ם, alternatives ס/מ). Nothing is written further left on the line (x~20-190 is plain surface). A curved stroke at x~315-345 sits low (y~120-190) and seems to belong to the line below. So the leftmost word is two letters: ו ם. If the fold does not mark a word boundary, the two box letters just right of it (Stage-1 pos 21 ם and pos 22 ט/ס, x~380-500) would make a four-sign group. I did not identify a word beginning ה-צ with certainty (the nearest candidates are pos 19 ח/ה and pos 20, a small flag-shaped sign).
P28.evidence: A grid zoom x~20-380 and x~150-470; B strip 1 (x~180-480): box at B x~250-290 and an upright at ~325 match A's box + upright, with a thin crack at ~375 and the dark fold band at ~420-450.

P29.answer: The first visible word (right end, starting at the edge of the large lacuna) shows 5 letters: ו ו ע ק + a final roofed letter (Stage-1 pos 1-5). Between ק (pos 4, x~940-1005) and the next letter (pos 5, x~865-915) A has only a very faint thin stroke at x~920-925 (y~80-120), which I take for a crack. C shows no separate upright between the box letter (ק) and the next letter. So there is probably no ו between ק and the following letter. That following letter is ר-like in A (one leg) but in C has two legs with the left one rising above the roof (the cross form read as ת in other lines). The first one or two uprights (pos 1-2) could belong to a preceding word lost in the lacuna.
P29.evidence: A grid zoom x~850-1020; C strip 1 grid zoom x~400-640 (box with dark hole = pos 4; roofed two-legged letter at C x~440-480; crack region at C x~480-520).

P29.answer: Taking the two identical letters pos 6-7 (short top with a tick, right upright, long base; A x~625-765) as the ככ pair: after a word space (x~565-620) come (1) one hook-shaped sign: a top bar with a thick diagonal descending from its right end to the lower left (x~500-555; '7'-shaped); (2)-(4) three vertical strokes with small heads (x~430-442, 445-460, 465-482); then (5) a curved stroke descending below the baseline (x~410-425), which may be a fourth stroke or damage, and (6) a faint upright with a short roof-like stroke at x~345-390. Count: 1 hook sign + 3 vertical strokes certain in shape, possibly a 4th stroke.
P29.evidence: A grid zoom x~330-560; B strip 3 grid zoom (x~890-1090): the diagonal of the hook sign at B x~1040-1075 and uprights at ~955, ~970, ~982 plus a fainter one at ~937.

P30.answer: I could not securely locate a ש-ל followed by ב-י-ת on this line, so I cannot say which word is meant. Two candidates for the final letter of the word in question: (1) At A x~1099-1165 (Stage-1 pos 6), C strip 3 shows a large closed box (trapezoid with a hook at the top left, closed at the left side and base), which is a ם-like closed box. A shows here only a curled top, a right upright and a long base, with the left side not visible, so A and C disagree. (2) At A x~1015-1025 (Stage-1 pos 9) there is a long straight vertical from above the line down into the line below (y~60-178), which looks like ן in A. But C shows it as a bright ridge, not a dark groove, so it is probably a fold/crack rather than an engraved stroke. On balance the closed-box reading has better radiographic support, but I cannot tie it to the word asked about.
P30.evidence: A grid zooms (x~960-1200 full height; whole line in three parts); C strip 3 grid zoom (x~1050-1330): box at C x~1223-1273, loop letter at ~1183-1217, bright vertical at ~1150, roof-with-two-legs letter at ~1113-1150.
